event.description: Repair embedding call in structured position candidate
event.proposal: family: position representation; implementation repair of attempt-0004. Retained incumbent is 5056 parameters at 99.9800%, a +0.98 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: none; same-family failed results: attempt-0003 nonqualification at 0.01% and attempt-0004 implementation error before scoring; prior attempts in this family: 2. Attempt-0004's train log shows the intended 4784-parameter seven-segment/eleven-column candidate failed only because an nn.Embedding module was indexed with brackets, raising TypeError before the first batch. This repair changes only those two calls to normal embedding-module invocation; it is more informative than a new position hypothesis because it recovers the already-specified candidate without altering its architecture or training conditions. Train for 15000 steps with final-checkpoint fallback; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 5056 parameters.
